writer.name: gen-squashfs.py
writer.block_encoder: gzip=zlib level 9, comp_id 1; xz=.xz container/CRC32, comp_id 4 (replaces stock raw-LZMA2 and comp_id 2)

fixtures.resolution: committed copy under --fixtures-dir, else the cache under --scratch, else the pinned URL with --fetch; each candidate is sha256-checked
fixtures.damage_recipe: pinned 4-byte zero window at damage_offset; pre-verified with sasquatch 4.5.1 + REA 6.5.0, never probed at run time

tuple_check.rule: R42-CL1 (QUALITY 85): a declared feature tuple is written into the manifest only after this generator MEASURED the same six fields in the envelope its own --run produced for that carrier (observed_features, over the artifact on disk) and found them EQUAL; on any difference it writes NO manifest and exits 3 (declared_tuple_unobserved).

new_label_tokens_binding: draft42 tokens are the round-42 precedence text verbatim (rule 1-13); the frozen SKILL v4 action line decides, and a mismatch is a loud exit (--actions-set/--actions-file; carriers do not change)

precedence_observations.measured: CONFIRMED: unblob SquashFSExtractor runs `sasquatch -be` for a v1-v3 BIG-endian chunk (handler version != 4), and the failing Command reports its own executable (unblob/extractors/command.py:68-73), so D = ['sasquatch'] and rule 3 answers (dep-missing-le, install-extractor-le) for a big-endian legacy chunk.

precedence_observations.claim: a v1-v3 body failure lands legacy-body-failure
precedence_observations.measured: CONFIRMED on all 14 pinned fixtures x both endianness strata: G={extractor-failure}, P=0, argv -be/-le recorded, handler from the v1-v3 family.

REFINED: only when an extraction actually reached the ceiling.  A clean chunk at --max-depth 1 mints it; a FAILING root chunk mints nothing (G={extractor-failure} only). A failing non-root chunk does not suppress it, because the sibling chunk still hits the ceiling.

types.handler_set: sorted list of handler names (empty = no chunk)
types.be_argv: 'yes' | 'no' | 'n/a' -- whether a recorded extractor child argv carries -be; 'n/a' when no argv is recorded (a successful run records none)

declared_schema.location: carriers[].declared_features -- ONE key for every class, combos included (R41-CL1).  There is no `declared` key and no `class_expected.features` key; declared_extras carries extraction_failed and max_depth, which are NOT part of the binding
declared_schema.finalization: ROUND 43 (QUALITY 85 / R42-CL1): the manifest is written ONLY after the generator measured every carrier's six-field tuple in the envelope its own --run produced and found it equal to the declared tuple; on any difference it writes NO manifest and exits 3 (declared_tuple_unobserved).  On agreement it records the measurement under generator.tuple_check (per carrier {observed, declared, equal: true} + the rule text).  The declaration itself stays a pure function of the class/factors and is never copied from a run.

combo.note: factorial: expected tuple computed from the drawn factors, label given by the evaluator only

combo_unseen.definition: a combo is UNSEEN when its observed feature tuple is outside the union of the NAMED classes' declared tuples; the union is the dev arm's, so the only way to carry this at the freeze is a lookup control's own key set
combo_unseen.note: declared_outside is the prediction from the declared tuples; --verify recomputes it from the OBSERVED tuples and prints both.  The two agree whenever the binding observed_features_match_declared holds.

chunks.role: valid image, zero regular files (depth ceiling, publishes nothing)
